# data-visualisation-9A7F184F

**MUST_NOT:** Do not truncate the y-axis when users must compare different values on the graph.

## Rationale

Truncation exaggerates differences and leads to erroneous relative-value inferences.

## Sources

- **https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/**
  - weight: 0.7
  - sourced: fetched
  > However, truncating the y-axis would not be acceptable if the main user task were to compare different values on the graph.
